articles.title: Australia plans capital gains tax changes affecting crypto investors: Report
articles.snippet: The Albanese government’s budget plans to replace the 50% capital gains tax discount on assets held over 12 months with a model taxing full real gains adjusted for inflation.

articles.title: South Korea crypto holdings halve in a year as investors turn to stock market
articles.snippet: South Korean crypto holdings fell to $41 billion from $83 billion in just over a year as investors shifted to stocks.

articles.title: OpenAI Just Launched a Consulting Arm to Help Companies Deploy AI
articles.snippet: The OpenAI Deployment Company launches with $4 billion, 19 investors, and a Palantir-style playbook to embed engineers inside enterprises.

articles.title: Tom Lee’s BitMine Slows Ethereum Buying Pace, Adding $62 Million in ETH
articles.snippet: Ethereum treasury firm BitMine Immersion Technologies slowed its ETH purchase pace, adding just $62 million worth last week.
